world.origin: front-left corner of the HMX035CTFT-001 touch/view plane at the antenna-side edge
world.x_axis: right when viewing the finished front face
world.y_axis: from the antenna edge toward the bottom/service edge
world.z_axis: from the touch/view plane toward the rear battery face

front-outer.world_transform: xw=x, yw=y, zw=3.2 for the UI PCB surface; outward bodies extend toward -z

ui-inner.local_view: authored in the front-face X/Y datum; rendered from the inner side by visual X mirroring only
ui-inner.world_transform: xw=x, yw=y, zw=4.8; bodies extend toward +z

rf-inner.local_view: authored as seen from the rear exterior
rf-inner.world_transform: xw=75-x-width, yw=y, zw=15.8; bodies extend toward -z

rear-outer.world_transform: xw=75-x-width for bodies or xw=75-x for axes, yw=y, zw=17.4; outward bodies extend toward +z

mounting_holes.axis: parallel to world Z through both PCBs
mounting_holes.compression_stops: four exact 11.00-mm nonconductive sleeves/stops define the interboard gap; screw clamp load closes through the stops, never through M1
mounting_holes.one_loose_screw_case: two enclosure anti-shear datums plus independent PCB capture lips prevent relative board motion when any one screw is loosened by one turn

antenna_planes.mounting: both GCT connector banks are soldered on outward PCB faces and no connector body enters the 11-mm interboard channel

battery_holder.mounting: SMT with enclosure cradle/end-stop load path

enclosure_reference.locked: world datum, PCB outlines, mounting axes, touch plane, external interface directions and component/accessory keep-outs
enclosure_reference.not_yet_locked: wall thickness, ribs, seals, bezel, grille, external fillets and manufacturing tolerance stack
enclosure_reference.rule: later enclosure surfaces may grow around the locked component model but may not move an accepted PCB/interface datum silently
enclosure_reference.mandatory_load_paths: front/rear PCB capture lips, two anti-shear datums, four 11.00-mm compression stops and a Keystone 1048P cradle/end-stop pair are required before enclosure release
